description_en: Creates a Formation Crawler metadata discovery task in an AnalyticDB for MySQL (ADB) instance
description_zh: 在ADB实例中创建Formation Crawler元数据发现任务
kebab_example: aliyun adb create-formation-crawler --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --crawler-info sourceType_:_OSSWAREHOUSE_,_dbName_:_your_target_db_,_sourceInfo_:_ossSourceInfo_:_sourceMode_:_WAREHOUSE_,_ossLocations_:_oss://your-bucket/your-path/_,_exclusions_:_,_inclusions_:_,_classifiers_:_csv_,_schemaChangePolicy_:_updateRule_:_ONLY_ADD_COLUMN_,_deleteRule_:_IGNORE_,_frequency_:_type_:_monthly_,_cron_:_0+00+00+1+0+0+0_,_configuration_:_adb.crawler.csv.columns.specify.delimiter.char=auto_nadb.crawler.csv.columns.specify.quote.char=auto_n --db-cluster-id am-bp00000 --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateFormationCrawler
